brief: Original project brief, item by item, mapped to the shipped location.

items.item: Collect and analyse live upcoming poker tournaments near the Las Vegas Strip, ranked by cost vs prize pool, with single-entry events as the focus.
items.notes: 341 rows carry date, buy-in, guarantee and a Pool ÷ fee ratio column, single-entry filtered by default; F31 keeps open that no sheet confirms a one-entry-per-player maximum.

items.item: Keep double-buy-in, re-entry and add-on tournaments in a separate section.
items.notes: entryType categories (extra, satellite, unverified) render as their own sections/filters; F11 records the NYE sheets whose multi-entry wording disagrees with the schedule page.

items.item: List hotels within a 30-minute walk of those tournaments, ranked by cost and quality first and distance second.
items.notes: 8 properties ranked on published cost components plus quality facts, with all 56 hotel–venue walking pairs measured (F32 keeps the estimate-only caveat; F19/F39 record components no property publishes).

items.item: Compute a true cost per night as rate + resort fee + tax.
items.notes: trueNightly floor/ceiling columns plus the dated trip quote; F51 keeps the fee-inclusion ambiguity of the $119 poker rate visible, F37 the missing room-tax percentage at other properties.

items.item: Build a day-by-day tournament schedule starting at 8 AM and running all day, maximising the number of tournaments played.
items.notes: A 7-day plan ships with primaries and fallbacks, but no official source publishes an 8:00 AM start (earliest verified is 9:00 AM) or finish times, so the day boundaries are estimates, not published hours.

items.item: Ship a trip cost calculator of entries × buy-ins + nights × true hotel cost.
items.notes: Preset ranges plus the published-model floor and the dated 23–30 Nov quote ($4,010.55); F54 flags the two planned nights that fail the poker-rate earning condition, F15 that engine totals move day over day.

items.item: Keep dated hotel rate logs: checkout total, nightly average, resort fee, tax, parking, cancellation deadline, timestamp, compared like for like.
items.notes: rateLog carries every observation appended with its date and source, newest first, including the itemized trip-window checkout total (a second same-evening read returned a different suite and total, kept as F88) and the printed poker-room parking waiver on both Venetian rows (F86); F39 keeps the missing room-tax percentages visible.

items.item: Publish a page per venue.
items.notes: Venue cards plus dedicated Venetian, Wynn and multi-property pages, each row linking its official poker page.

items.item: Provide global search across the tables.
items.notes: Header search on every page queries tournaments, hotels, venues, flags, questions and sources in one box.

items.item: Provide a date filter.
items.notes: Date range filter over the tournament table with the plan window preloaded.

items.item: Check schedule overlaps and give each day a primary and a fallback.
items.notes: dayPlan rows carry primary, fallback and fallbackReason; planConflicts lists the detected overlaps (Day-2 restarts against same-morning primaries).

items.item: Check walking routes and apply a 30-minute limit.
items.notes: All 56 hotel–venue pairs carry a Maps estimate with its live Maps link and per-row last-checked date; rows over 30 minutes are labelled, and the schedule filter applies the limit to the plan's Venetian walks.

items.item: Re-check official URLs on a schedule and mark changed rows.
items.notes: The scheduled workflow records a per-URL change log (changed / unchanged / unavailable with reason) and re-baselines when the comparison basis changes; F40 records that some venue hosts are unreachable from the CI sandbox and are published as unavailable rather than silently unchanged.

items.item: Show a last-checked column.
items.notes: lastChecked / lastVerified render on every event, rate-log, route and source row; blanks render as 'Not recorded', never as a date.

items.item: Remove the 'unverified' label only when a value is confirmed.
items.notes: 11 rows remain in the unverified category; the sheet-verification page shows which rows a structure sheet has screened and the transcription check keeps unmatched rows visible.

items.item: Carry structured rule fields (single-entry / re-entry / add-on / fee) with a source excerpt and retrieval date.
items.notes: Each event's rules object holds status, excerpt and retrieval date per rule; the tournaments table renders entry check and late registration from it.

items.item: Rank only after confirming entry fee and guarantee; show guaranteed pool ÷ entry fee as a descriptive ratio; label bounty and flight events.
items.notes: Rows without a confirmed fee or guarantee keep the field blank and are not ranked; the ratio column states it is descriptive only; bounty/flight wording follows the printed name (F24 flags added-money wording, F31 the entry rule).

items.item: Publish an executive summary.
items.notes: Landing dashboard: plan, costs, open questions and flagged count at a glance.

items.item: Publish a Q&A page of the questions that must be answered before decisions.
items.notes: 18 questions (Q01–Q18) with answer state, blocking marker and official source.

items.item: Publish a suggestions page for the user to choose paths.
items.notes: Each suggestion states the choice, its trade-off and the official evidence behind it.

items.item: Review the repository line by line, give links for manual review, and flag irregularities.
items.notes: 61 flags with severity, detail and official source link form the irregularity register; sources.html lists every official URL for manual review; the review log lives in COORDINATION.md.

items.item: Publish a GitHub Pages site: a clean dashboard landing page, category subpages, simple readable tables and analysis.
items.notes: Static site under site/, built by scripts/data_source.py and deployed by the pages workflow; this matrix page is part of it.

items.item: Verification standard: every row links an official source, unconfirmable values stay blank and flagged, nothing is inferred.
items.notes: Enforced by scripts/verify_site.py (official-domain allowlist, blank-not-fabricated rule, flag coverage, local links) on every build and in CI.

items.item: Coordinate parallel sessions through a shared COORDINATION.md: claim before starting, non-overlapping scopes, small commits, rebase before push, log conflicts.
items.notes: Claim tables, session logs and conflict records are kept at the repository root and pushed with every claim.

items.item: Final integration: open a PR to main with change summary, sources and flagged irregularities; merge without approval; confirm the Pages deploy; record the PR link and merge result in COORDINATION.md; flagged items appear on the Flagged for Review page and never block a green merge.
items.notes: Claimed as T5 of this session; the PR link and merge result are appended to COORDINATION.md when it completes.
